name: r6-mut-once-padded-key
description: Mutation triage (inventory pass, valve-once/grace-cutoff and valve-clock-sync rows): a ONCE schedule 30 minutes late on a valve whose stored key is tab-padded (devices.deveui and valve_schedules.device_eui both '\tKEY\t'). Node-RED's grace skip marks the intent SKIPPED and logs the SKIP event, but store.updateSchedule binds the trimmed, upper-cased scope, so UPPER(device_eui)=? matches no row and the schedule stays PENDING with its sync_version. Go bound the raw stored key and marked the schedule SKIPPED. The lower-case and plain keys are controls (both sides mark them SKIPPED). B4 is a due ONCE schedule on a padded key: Node-RED opens the valve (normalizeDevice trims the key), finalizeOnceAccepted reads the expectation by command_id alone and records proof 'receipt' in its transport_json, and updateSchedule again matches no row. Go read the expectation by command_id and the raw padded key, found none, and left the proof out. B5 is a SKIPPED uncertain one-time open on a padded key whose open was observed: Node-RED's late correction records the proof, the IRRIGATE event and the actuator_log row, and its updateSchedule matches no row, so the schedule stays SKIPPED. Go updated the schedule without a device scope and marked it FIRED.
